     1	# Service component
     2	
     3	Fix transfer(connection, publisher, source, target, amount) in src/service.py. A successful transfer debits and credits exactly once, appends one ledger row, commits, then publishes {'source': source, 'target': target, 'amount': amount}. source and target must differ and exist; amount is a positive integer, excluding bool, and cannot exceed the source balance. Invalid transfers raise ValueError without writes or publication. Database failure at any statement or commit rolls back all changes and never publishes. Publication failure propagates after the committed transfer and must not undo it. Caller connections are idle at entry. Keep balance reads and account setup intact. Start in src/service.py and src/repository.py.
